sections.text_helper: Section 32.4.18 "Timing" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1487.
sections.section_content:
The elapsed time between the start of a conversion and the end of a conversion is the sum
of the configured sampling time plus the successive approximation time depending on data
resolution:
TCONV= TSMPL + TSAR = [1.5 |min + 13.5 |12bit] x TADC_CLK
TCONV = TSMPL + TSAR = 50 ns |min + 450 ns |12bit = 500 ns (for Fadc_ker_ck = 30 MHz)
[Figure 268. Analog-to-digital conversion time]
1. AIN represents the input voltage captured by the internal Sample and Hold (S/H) capacitor.
2. tSMPL depends on SMP[2:0].
3. tSAR depends on RES[2:0].
Note: The bulb and the sampling time control trigger modes are not described in Figure268:
Analog-to-digital conversion time.
